description: Simulates pre-sign EVM calldata (to, data, optional from and wei value defaulting to '0') across five chains (chainId default 8453 Base) to block drainers before wallet signing. Strictly read-only: decodes ERC-20 approve, NFT setApprovalForAll, EIP-2612/Permit2 signatures, and recursive multicall while reading live RPC bytecode and EIP-1967/1167 slots to return SAFE/WARNING/BLOCK_DRAINER (PROCEED/CAUTION/ABORT) and unsigned revocation calldata. Costs $0.10 USDC on Base via x402 v2 (unpaid returns isError: true); active critical compromises require 0.15% SLA or 5%-10% Safe-Harbor bounty settlement to unmask spender coordinates. Call before signing transactions; use ingravity_scanTokenRugpullAndHoneypot for token due diligence without calldata.

capitalAtRiskUsd.description: Optional protected capital value in USD for +0.15% Pre-Flight SLA / Safe-Harbor rescue quoting.

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID for live RPC bytecode/EIP-1967 inspection (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

data.description: Hexadecimal transaction calldata (0x...); pass '0x' for a plain native ETH transfer.

from.description: Optional sender wallet address (0x...) also matched against active ZK-EC whale exposure dossiers.

ticketId.description: Optional ZK-EC blinded exposure ticket ID (TICKET-8453-...) to unseal full remediation coordinates upon x402 rescue settlement.

to.description: Target EVM contract, token, or recipient 42-character hex address (0x...).

value.description: Optional native ETH value in wei as a decimal string.

name: ingravity_inspectEvmTransactionFirewall

agentDirective.description: Execution directive explaining how to proceed or revoke.

chainId.description: Resolved EVM chain ID used for live RPC inspection.

decodedParams.description: Decoded ABI arguments (e.g., spender, operator, owner, value, deadline).

executableRemediationTx.description: Unsigned EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls and approve(spender, 0) calldata when spender is decoded (or lock notice when masked in pre-flight tier).

liveOnChainForensics.description: Live 5-EVM RPC bytecode and EIP-1967 proxy slot inspection (null when unavailable or malformed).

savedCapitalEstimateUsd.description: Estimated wallet value protected if drainer blocked.

selector.description: 4-byte function selector ('0x' for empty calldata, 'INVALID' if malformed hex).

settled.description: Whether x402 USDC payment settled cleanly.

triggers.description: Triggered drainer/permission heuristics and RPC checks.
